questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word DISPLAY be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2009)
questions.explanation: DISPLAY has 7 distinct letters. Total ways = 7! = 5040.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word SMART be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2009)
questions.explanation: SMART has 5 distinct letters. Total ways = 5! = 120 (Not in a, b, c, d).

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word FORMULATE be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2008)
questions.explanation: FORMULATE has 9 distinct letters. Total ways = 9! = 362880.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word GAMBLE be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2010)
questions.explanation: GAMBLE has 6 distinct letters. Total ways = 6! = 720.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word RIDDLED be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2006)
questions.explanation: RIDDLED has 7 letters with 3 D's. Total ways = 7! / 3! = 5040 / 6 = 840.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word CREATE be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2011)
questions.explanation: CREATE has 6 letters with 2 E's. Total ways = 6! / 2! = 360.

questions.explanation: TOTAL has 5 letters with 2 T's. Total ways = 5! / 2! = 60.

questions.explanation: OFFICES has 7 letters with 2 F's. Total ways = 7! / 2! = 2520.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word BANANA be arranged?
questions.explanation: BANANA has 6 letters with 3 A's and 2 N's. Total ways = 6! / (3! × 2!) = 720 / 12 = 60.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word WEDDING be arranged? (Bank P.O., 2008)
questions.explanation: WEDDING has 7 letters with 2 D's. Total ways = 7! / 2! = 2520.

questions.explanation: ABSENTEE has 8 letters with 3 E's. Total ways = 8! / 3! = 40320 / 6 = 6720.

questions.explanation: AWARE has 5 letters with 2 A's. Total ways = 5! / 2! = 60.

questions.explanation: RUMOUR has 6 letters with 2 R's and 2 U's. Total ways = 6! / (2! × 2!) = 720 / 4 = 180.

questions.explanation: OPERATE has 7 letters with 2 E's. Total ways = 7! / 2! = 2520.

questions.explanation: PUNCTUAL has 8 letters with 2 U's. Total ways = 8! / 2! = 20160.

questions.question: Out of 5 men and 3 women, a committee of three members is to be formed so that it has 1 woman and 2 men. In how many different ways can it be done? (Bank P.O., 2009)
Out of 5 women and 4 men, a committee of three members is to be formed in such a way that at least one member is a woman. In how many different ways can it be done? (Bank P.O., 2009)
questions.explanation: Total ways to choose 3 from 9 = 9C3 = 84. Ways with all men = 4C3 = 4. Ways with at least 1 woman = 84 - 4 = 80.

questions.question: A committee of 5 members is to be formed out of 3 trainees, 4 professors and 6 research associates. In how many different ways can this be done, if the committee should have 4 professors and 1 research associate or all 3 trainees and 2 professors? (S.B.I. P.O., 2010)
questions.explanation: Ways = (4C4 × 6C1) + (3C3 × 4C2) = (1 × 6) + (1 × 6) = 12. Correct answer is 12 (Option a is 12!).

questions.question: A committee of 5 members is to be formed out of 3 trainees, 4 professors and 6 research associates. In how many different ways can this be done if the committee should have 2 trainees and 3 research associates? (S.B.I. P.O., 2010)
In how many ways can a committee of 4 people be chosen out of 8 people? (Bank P.O., 2007)
A committee of 5 members is to be formed by selecting out of 4 men and 5 women. In how many different ways the committee can be formed if it should have 2 men and 3 women? (Bank P.O., 2005)
A committee of 5 members is to be formed by selecting out of 4 men and 5 women. In how many different ways the committee can be formed if it should have at least 1 man? (Bank P.O., 2011)
questions.explanation: Total ways = 9C5 = 126. Ways with no men (5 women) = 5C5 = 1. Ways with at least 1 man = 126 - 1 = 125.

questions.question: In how many ways a committee consisting of 5 men and 6 women can be formed from 8 men and 10 women? (Bank P.O., 2009)
A select group of 4 is to be formed from 8 men and 6 women in such a way that the group must have at least 1 woman. In how many different ways can it be done? (Bank P.O., 2005)
questions.explanation: Total ways = 14C4 = 1001. Ways with all men = 8C4 = 70. Ways with at least 1 woman = 1001 - 70 = 931.

questions.question: From a group of 7 men and 6 women, 5 persons are to be selected to form a committee so that at least 3 men are there on the committee. In how many ways can it be done?
A box contains 2 white, 3 black and 4 red balls. In how many ways can 3 balls be drawn from the box, if at least 1 black ball is to be included in the draw?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 9. Total ways = 9C3 = 84. Ways without black (only white/red = 6) = 6C3 = 20. Ways with at least 1 black = 84 - 20 = 64.

questions.question: In how many ways can a group of 5 men and 2 women be made out of a total of 7 men and 3 women?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word ENGINEERING be arranged?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word ALLAHABAD be arranged?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word JUDGE be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together?
questions.explanation: Vowels U, E as 1 unit + 3 consonants (J, D, G) = 4 items. Ways = 4! × 2! = 24 × 2 = 48.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word AUCTION be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together? (Bank P.O., 2010)
questions.explanation: Vowels A, U, I, O as 1 unit + 3 consonants (C, T, N) = 4 items. Ways = 4! × 4! = 24 × 24 = 576.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word SOFTWARE be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together? (Bank P.O., 2009)
questions.explanation: Vowels O, A, E as 1 unit + 5 consonants = 6 items. Ways = 6! × 3! = 720 × 6 = 4320.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word OPTICAL be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together?
questions.explanation: Vowels O, I, A as 1 unit + 4 consonants = 5 items. Ways = 5! × 3! = 120 × 6 = 720.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word BANKING be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together? (Bank P.O., 2009)
questions.explanation: Vowels A, I as 1 unit + 5 consonants (B, N, K, N, G with 2 N's) = 6 items. Ways = (6! / 2!) × 2! = 720.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word CAPITAL be arranged so that the vowels always come together? (Bank P.O. 2012)
questions.explanation: Vowels A, I, A as 1 unit (with 2 A's) + 4 consonants = 5 items. Ways = 5! × (3! / 2!) = 120 × 3 = 360.

questions.question: In how many ways can the letters of the word MATHEMATICS be arranged so that all the vowels always come together?
questions.explanation: Vowels A, E, A, I (2 A's) as 1 unit + 7 consonants (M, T, H, M, T, C, S with 2 M's, 2 T's) = 8 items. Ways = (8! / (2! × 2!)) × (4! / 2!) = 10080 × 12 = 120960.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word CORPORATION be arranged so that the vowels always come together? (Bank P.O. 2011)
questions.explanation: Vowels O, O, A, I, O (3 O's) as 1 unit + 6 consonants (C, R, P, R, T, N with 2 R's) = 7 items. Ways = (7! / 2!) × (5! / 3!) = 2520 × 20 = 50400.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word MACHINE be arranged so that the vowels may occupy only the odd positions?
questions.explanation: 7 letters: 4 odd positions (1, 3, 5, 7), 3 vowels (A, I, E). Vowels in odd positions = 4P3 = 24. Consonants in remaining 4 positions = 4! = 24. Total = 24 × 24 = 576.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word EXTRA be arranged so that the vowels are never together?
questions.explanation: Total ways = 5! = 120. Vowels (E, A) together = 4! × 2! = 48. Vowels never together = 120 - 48 = 72.

questions.question: In an examination there are three multiple choice questions and each question has 4 choices. The number of ways in which a student can fail to get all answers correct is [MAT, 2012]
questions.explanation: Total response outcomes = 4³ = 64. Exactly 1 way to get all correct. Ways to fail to get all correct = 64 - 1 = 63.

questions.question: There are six teachers. Out of them two are primary teachers and two are secondary teachers. They are to stand in a row, so as the primary teachers, middle teachers and secondary teachers are always in a set. The number of ways in which they can do so, is [MAT, 2011]
questions.explanation: 3 sets of 2 teachers each. Arrangement of 3 sets = 3! = 6. Internal arrangements = 2! × 2! × 2! = 8. Total ways = 6 × 8 = 48.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word ‘BAKERY’ be arranged? [SBI— Bank Clerical Exam, 2012]
questions.explanation: BAKERY has 6 distinct letters. Total ways = 6! = 720.

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word ‘TRANSPIRATION’ be arranged so that the vowels always come together? [DMRC—Train Operator/Station Controller Exam, 2016]
questions.explanation: Vowels A, I, A, I, O (2 A's, 2 I's) as 1 unit + 8 consonants (T, R, N, S, P, R, T, N with 2 T's, 2 R's, 2 N's) = 9 items. Ways = (9! / (2! × 2! × 2!)) × (5! / (2! × 2!)) = 45360 × 30 = 1360800.

questions.question: In how many ways can the letters of the word ‘MOMENT’ be arranged? [UPSSSC—Lower Subordinate (Pre.) Exam, 2016]
questions.explanation: MOMENT has 6 letters with 2 M's. Total ways = 6! / 2! = 360.

key_explanation_from_book.factorial: For a positive integer n, n! = n × (n−1) × (n−2) × ... × 2 × 1.
key_explanation_from_book.permutation: The number of permutations of n different things taken r at a time is nPr = n!/(n−r)!.
key_explanation_from_book.combination: The number of combinations of n different things taken r at a time is nCr = n!/[r!(n−r)!].
key_explanation_from_book.repeated_objects: When objects are repeated, the number of distinct arrangements is n!/(p!q!r!...), where p, q, r are the repetition counts.
